The full layer read Zaahen, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Zaahen, Kayle, Kayle while whys[0] says 'Level 1 is even', whys[1-3] say he dominates 2 through 5, whys[4] says 'Level 6 is even', whys[5] says 'the lane turns neutral', and only whys[6] gives it to Kayle.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entire full layer tracks a placeholder called 'Ultimate' — focus.text, loading, tldr, winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull, dontsFull and six report rows all say 'Ultimate' instead of an ability name. No cooldown appears anywhere, and his revive passive is never mentioned.
audit.why: His R is Grim Deliverance, 110/95/80s at 600 range, and it heals him for a portion of damage dealt. Q (The Darkin Glaive) is 10/9/8/7/6s, heals him, resets his auto, and recasts into a knockup — so the attack wind-up is the tell. E (Aureate Rush) is a 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s dash dealing percent-health damage, which means raw armour stacking is the wrong answer and range alone will not keep him off you. His W pulls from 850 range on 14s. Most importantly the passive, Determination, lets him REVIVE at full stacks — that changes every all-in decision and appears nowhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Real name, 110s cooldown, the Q auto-reset tell, the E dash and the revive passive are now on the full layer.
sources: missingInteractions ability names: The Darkin Glaive (Q), Aureate Rush (E), Grim Deliverance (R)

edits.before: New-champ respect — survive his early, out-scale him. Kayle wins the Ultimate cooldown windows.
edits.after: Survive levels 2-5, then out-scale. Grim Deliverance is 110s at rank 1 and heals him.

edits.before: You are the weakest level 1 in the game — pay rent quietly. Identify how Zaahen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 is even before his walk-down pressure begins — take the safe last-hits and learn where his 850-range pull can reach you.

edits.before: E-poke softens his step-ups while you scale. Only take the trade when Zaahen's Ultimate is down.
edits.after: At 2 he punishes your dashless melee frame every trade — his Q heals him and resets his auto.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Zaahen must walk into your range.
edits.after: Level 3 favours him: he starves the farm and XP you need. Aureate Rush is a 10s dash, so range is no escape.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ultimate's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Through 4-5 he dominates your pre-form frame and taxes your scaling — buy Grievous Wounds before you take any long trade.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Zaahen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Level 6 is even: R's invulnerability is defensive, so he still out-duels you cleanly, but he can no longer dive you for free at all.

edits.before: Nashor's Tooth is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Ultimate's cooldown.
edits.after: The lane turns neutral — Nashor's and ranged form let you farm safely out of his reach.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Zaahen carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: By two items your full-build DPS out-damages him and kites his 600-range R — the 1v1 and the side lane are yours.

edits.before: - Zaahen Ultimate: matchup-defining — His big cooldown. R-invuln it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Zaahen Grim Deliverance: matchup-defining — 110s at rank 1 and it heals him; R through it. - The Darkin Glaive: 10s auto reset, recast knocks up. - Aureate Rush: 10s dash, percent-HP damage.

edits.after: Track Grim Deliverance before you commit

edits.before: His big cooldown. R-invuln it. Only engage once it is down or baited.

notes: This matchup had the single largest full/content divergence in the slice — six of seven level-chart rows rendered the opposite answer to the whys directly beside them. Separately, the whole page uses the placeholder word 'Ultimate' in place of an ability name; I replaced it everywhere the length band allowed, but focus.text ('Zaahen Ultimate', 15 chars, under the applier's 25-char skip threshold), the loading line, winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.mid, breakdown.early, breakdown.trading, ahead and report rows 1, 9, 10, 12, 13 still say 'Ultimate' and need a template-level find-and-replace to 'Grim Deliverance'. Zaahen's W name is not present in any data I was given, so I referred to it only by its 850 range and pull effect. His passive Determination grants a REVIVE at full stacks — verified from the kit text and previously absent from the page entirely.
